name: Behavioral Whiplash
description: Benchmark data and summary artifacts accompanying Behavioral Whiplash v1.1.1, an open-source behavioral honeypot and telemetry suite for evaluating LLM agent discontinuities in multi-turn verification. The dataset contains the original v1.0 four-cohort benchmark artifacts and the v1.1 extended benchmark artifacts covering six synthetic cohorts. The v1.1 benchmark contains 210 synthetic trials, with 35 trials per cohort sampled with replacement from five predefined response-pair templates. These data support reproducibility of the reported descriptive benchmark results and scoring pipeline. The benchmark is synthetic and does not represent independent live LLM runs or real human populations.
